results.summary: This design implements a 2-digit full adder whose 3-bit sum is displayed on the segments f, b, and e of a 7-segment display. It also includes a clock divider that divides a 10 kHz clock by 2^16 to toggle the decimal point. The included truth table shows the expected segment outputs for several 4-bit input combinations. Built in Wokwi using switches for inputs and an external 7-segment display, it is a small educational project.
